d:
Tapu Sena stages an emotional play titled "A Night to Remember" in Gokuldham Society. Through the touching story of Raju, a young boy whose family can't afford surgery to save his vision, and an interactive demonstration with Jethalal and Madhavi, they highlight the value of eyesight and the struggles faced by visually impaired individuals.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
